Name: Additional Statue Obelisks
Author: mostlystars
Description:
[size=3]This is a small mod that changes the appearance of the farm obelisk on Ginger Island as well as the Dam, East Scarp, Mount Vapius, Ridgeside Village & Downtown Zuzu obelisks to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7446]Kat’s wonderful Statue Obelisks[/url]![/size]

There are [b]three different versions[/b] available:

[list=1]
[*][Content Patcher] All 6 obelisks: Farm, Dam, ES, Mt. Vapius, RSV, Zuzu
[*][Content Patcher] Only farm obelisk
[*][Alternative Textures] The 5 “expansion pack” obelisks: Dam, ES, Mt. Vapius, RSV, Zuzu

[/list]The CP version obelisks can each be switched on/off.
All versions are seasonal, with a slight color change each season (see screenshot) to match the map. The farm obelisk also has a simple non-seasonal version that uses the summer variant as the default, but feel free to change it to the variant you prefer.
Two color options for Mount Vapius because I couldn't decide which one I preferred.
There’s no AT version of the farm obelisk because I have no idea how to make that work ¯\_(ツ)_/¯


[size=4]To install:
[/size][list=1]
[*][b]Install [/b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][b]Download [/b]the file you want to use
[*][b]Unzip [/b]it into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder
[*][i]Recommended: Also get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7446]Kat's Statue Obelisks[/url]﻿ and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16467]Deepwood Seasonal Statue[/url]﻿ to complete the set if you like![/i]

[/list][size=4]Art Credit:[/size]
None of the art is mine; I just slightly changed the palette of some sprites to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3368575]Kat’s[/url] statue bases, but it’s all used with permission.
Idea, statue bases and shadows from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7446]Kat’s Statue Obelisks[/url]
Statues of the following mods were used:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12089]Dam
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
